cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-830 specifically addresses inclusion of external web functionality/widgets from untrusted domains. The demonstrated behavior is parsing data type strings for AJAX pipeline registration, not including external web functionality.

connection.evidence: dataTypeExpression parameter can be externally controlled through jQuery.ajaxPrefilter/ajaxTransport calls, connecting to AJAX processing pipeline registration

diff_causality.evidence: If this line were reverted, dataTypeExpression would not be parsed into individual data types, preventing registration of handlers for malicious data types

security_control.required_control: Validation of data type strings before registration in AJAX pipeline
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: Untrusted data types could register malicious prefilters/transports
existing_controls_checked: Basic type check that defaults to "*" if not string
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No validation of data type format or allowlisting of permitted types before regex parsing and registration

concrete_impact.evidence: No evidence of concrete security impact from including web functionality; impact would be AJAX pipeline manipulation, not external functionality inclusion

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, dataTypeExpression would not be parsed into individual data types using regex, preventing the registration of AJAX prefilters/transports based on potentially malicious data type strings.
supporting_evidence: dataTypeExpression parameter can be externally controlled
Parsed data types register handlers in AJAX processing pipeline
contradicting_evidence: CWE-830 requires inclusion of external web functionality/widgets, but this code processes data type strings internally
No evidence of cross-domain functionality inclusion or widget loading
unresolved_facts: Whether malicious dataTypeExpression could actually bypass security controls
Specific security impact of registering malicious data type handlers
